subject: Decision Making
subcategory: The Science of Risk and Reward
title: What Is Risk?
description: A short lesson to help you apply What Is Risk?.

hook.text: Risk is the possibility that something bad will happen. We avoid it, chase it, and misjudge it constantly.

buildup.text: Humans survived by detecting threats fast. Our brains evolved to fear predators, heights, and strangers.

discovery.text: What Is Risk reveals the key principle behind better choices under uncertainty.

twist.text: We fear dramatic risks like plane crashes but ignore mundane ones like heart disease.

climax.text: Risk is not a feeling. It is a calculation. The gap between how we feel about risk and reality costs lives every day.

punchline.text: Sharks scare us, stairs kill us. We fear risk wrong and pay the price.

quiz.question: What are the two components of risk?
options: Probability and magnitude of the outcome
